notes.en: List proportional representation with 250 seats in one nationwide constituency. The National Assembly page reproducing this result prints only the lists that won seats (votes, percentage of voters who voted, seats) and the number of voters who voted; valid ballots, voters on the electoral roll and lists without seats are not printed, so no vote share over valid ballots and no turnout are given. The seats reproduce under the 2026 rule (3% threshold, 35% minority quotient increase), recorded as a consistency check only. List labels: full titles usually name persons and are not stored.
notes.zh-CN: 比例代表制，一个全国选区共 250 席。转载本届结果的国民议会网页只列出获得席位的名单（得票、占投票选民的百分比、席位）及投票选民人数；未列出有效票、登记选民人数和未获席位的名单，因此不提供以有效票为分母的得票率，也不提供投票率。席位可按 2026 年规则（3% 门槛、少数民族商数提高 35%）复现，仅作一致性核对。名单标签：完整名称通常含人名，不予存储。
